evals.expected_output: Enumerates org repos, lists failed runs from the trailing window, drops ignorable classes with reasons, and files one issue per repo+workflow.
evals.prompt: Check what CI failed across shikanime-labs in the last day and file the new failures.
assertions: Frontmatter description starts with 'Use when' and is at most 200 characters
Body contains at least one '##' heading
Body enumerates repos and failed workflow runs for a trailing window
Body files one issue per repo+workflow pair in the repo where it failed

evals.expected_output: A trivial CI yaml fix goes through the fastlane gate; bigger fixes stay open PRs and never wait on checks.
evals.prompt: The devlib CI is red because of a typo in the workflow yaml — fix it and get it merged.
assertions: Body routes trivial CI fixes (yaml fix, action pin, typo) through the fastlane gate
Body states ineligible or pending PRs are left open and never waited on

evals.expected_output: Renovate PR checks are out of scope here — the skill routes them to the renovate sweep instead of filing them.
evals.prompt: Sweep CI failures including all the renovate dependency PR checks.
assertions: Body excludes renovate PR checks from the audit scope

evals.expected_output: The skill stays loadable and self-identifies; a demand to build a new workflow is out of scope.
